channels.name: CAN bus (single channel)
channels.purpose: Single shared serial channel carrying NRZ-coded bit stream; dominant overrides recessive on simultaneous transmission. Logical interface exposed to M_CAN via m_can_tx / m_can_rx.
channels.physical_realization: Outside M_CAN. Typical: ISO 11898-2 high-speed differential (CANH/CANL) at 5+ Mbit/s data phase; ISO 11898-3 fault-tolerant low-speed; ISO 11898-6 partial networking.

channels.name: Generic Slave Interface (Host CPU)
channels.purpose: 8/16/32-bit memory-mapped access to M_CAN's 512-byte register map. Protected-write semantics for configuration.

channels.name: Generic Master Interface (Message RAM)
channels.purpose: Read / write to Message RAM (up to 4.25K × 32-bit per M_CAN instance, 16K × 32-bit absolute max). Watched by RAM Watchdog (RWD).

channels.name: Interrupt lines
channels.purpose: Two configurable interrupt lines m_can_int0 + m_can_int1; per-flag route via ILS; per-line enable via ILE.

channels.name: Extension Interface
channels.purpose: All IR flags + selected internal status/control signals routed for module-external observation (optional).

channels.name: TSU Interface
channels.purpose: 32-bit external timestamping. M_CAN signals Sync-message Rx/Tx via m_can_tsrx / m_can_tstx pulses; TSU returns 32-bit timestamp via its register identified by R1B.RXTSP / E1B.TXTSP.

channels.name: DMU Interface
channels.purpose: Debug-on-CAN hand-off. m_can_dma_req asserted when debug messages A/B/C stored; m_can_dma_ack from DMU resets it.

channels.name: Power-down Interface
channels.purpose: m_can_clkstop_req triggers clock-stop sequence; m_can_clkstop_ack reports ready-for-clock-stop.

logical_signal_states.name: dominant
logical_signal_states.rule: Wins simultaneous transmission (wired-AND). At m_can_tx output: driven low.

logical_signal_states.name: recessive
logical_signal_states.rule: Released; pulled to recessive by the physical layer. At m_can_tx output: driven high (released).

frame_fields_as_signal_segments_can_fd.name: CONTROL_FIELD_FD
frame_fields_as_signal_segments_can_fd.form: r1 + FDF=1 + res=0 + BRS + ESI + DLC[3:0]

frame_fields_as_signal_segments_can_fd.name: DATA_FIELD_FD
frame_fields_as_signal_segments_can_fd.form: 0..64 bytes per CAN FD DLC table; transmitted at DBTP rate if BRS=1

frame_fields_as_signal_segments_can_fd.name: STUFF_COUNT_FIELD_ISO
frame_fields_as_signal_segments_can_fd.form: 4 bits (3 stuff count + 1 parity) when CCCR.NISO = 0

frame_fields_as_signal_segments_can_fd.name: CRC_FIELD_FD
frame_fields_as_signal_segments_can_fd.form: 17-bit CRC (≤16 B) or 21-bit CRC (>16 B) + recessive delimiter; delimiter switches back to NBTP rate

frame_fields_as_signal_segments_can_fd.name: ACK_FIELD_FD
frame_fields_as_signal_segments_can_fd.form: 1 ACK slot + 1 recessive delimiter; ACK timing accounts for transmitter delay

module_ports_catalog.name: m_can_aei_ara
module_ports_catalog.purpose: Access to reserved register address signal.

module_ports_catalog.name: m_can_cok
module_ports_catalog.purpose: Clock Calibration on CAN unit input (0 forces Restricted Operation Mode).

module_ports_catalog.name: m_can_tsrx
module_ports_catalog.purpose: Pulse on Rx of Sync message (CCCR.UTSU = 1 + filter SSYNC/ESYNC = 1).

module_ports_catalog.name: m_can_tstx
module_ports_catalog.purpose: Pulse on Tx of Sync message (CCCR.UTSU = 1 + Tx Buffer T1.TSCE = 1).

module_ports_catalog.name: m_can_fe[2:0]
module_ports_catalog.purpose: Filter event pins, per SFID2[8:6] / EFID2[8:6].

module_ports_catalog.name: m_can_aeim_berr[1:0]
module_ports_catalog.purpose: Message RAM ECC/parity status — [0] corrected, [1] uncorrected.

module_ports_catalog.name: m_can_hclk
module_ports_catalog.purpose: Host clock (may be FM-PLL spread spectrum).

dependency_graph.common_rule: Single shared CAN channel: all nodes monitor every bit; dominant wins on collision. Bit timing synchronization is edge-driven on recessive-to-dominant edges. CAN FD adds: data-phase bit time (DBTP) used after BRS bit when BRS=1.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: Each bit is sampled at SAMPLE POINT (end of NTSEG1 in arbitration phase; end of DTSEG1 in data phase). Resynchronization adjusts NTSEG1/NTSEG2 (bounded by NSJW) or DTSEG1/DTSEG2 (bounded by DSJW) per phase error sign.
dependency_graph.ack_dependency: ACK SLOT response = OR of (CRC-matched ∧ ready) across all receivers. CAN FD ACK timing accounts for the transmitter delay.
dependency_graph.tdc_dependency: When DBTP.TDC = 1, transmitter-side data-phase bit-error check is performed at Secondary Sample Point (SSP) = measured_delay + TDCR.TDCO mtq.

handshake_pairs.name: ARBITRATION
handshake_pairs.rule: Bitwise on IDENTIFIER + RTR (Classical) or RRS (FD); loser withdraws on recessive-driven vs dominant-monitored mismatch.

handshake_pairs.name: ACK_SLOT_ACK
handshake_pairs.rule: Receivers superscribe transmitter's recessive ACK SLOT with dominant; CAN FD timing accounts for transmitter delay.

handshake_pairs.name: OVERLOAD_REQUEST
handshake_pairs.rule: Receiver drives OVERLOAD FLAG to delay next DATA/REMOTE FRAME (max 2 consecutive).

handshake_pairs.name: TXBAR / TXBRP
handshake_pairs.rule: TXBAR.AR_n = 1 → TXBRP.TRP_n = 1; cleared on Tx complete or cancellation.

handshake_pairs.name: RXF0A / F0GI
handshake_pairs.rule: Host writes RXF0A.F0AI = index of last-read element → M_CAN sets F0GI = F0AI + 1.

handshake_pairs.name: TXEFA / EFGI
handshake_pairs.rule: Host writes TXEFA.EFAI = index of last-read Tx Event FIFO element → M_CAN sets EFGI = EFAI + 1.

handshake_pairs.name: DMA_REQ / DMA_ACK
handshake_pairs.rule: Debug-on-CAN A+B+C stored → m_can_dma_req = 1; DMU reads + asserts m_can_dma_ack → m_can_dma_req = 0.

handshake_pairs.name: CLKSTOP_REQ / CLKSTOP_ACK
handshake_pairs.rule: Clock-stop request → after pending Tx + bus idle: CCCR.INIT + CCCR.CSA + m_can_clkstop_ack = 1.

ordering_rules.identifier_bits: MSB-first (ID-10 → ID-0 for 11-bit standard; ID-28 → ID-0 for 29-bit extended).
ordering_rules.global_ordering: Higher-priority IDENTIFIER (more dominant bits early) wins arbitration; messages with same IDENTIFIER serialized by re-arbitration.
ordering_rules.tx_fifo: M_CAN Tx FIFO transmits in put-order (oldest first).
ordering_rules.tx_queue: M_CAN Tx Queue transmits by lowest Message ID (highest priority first).
ordering_rules.mixed_dedicated_fifo_queue: All eligible Tx Buffers (dedicated + FIFO/Queue) scanned; lowest Message ID wins.
